name: bsnes-emu/bsnes
description: A high-accuracy Super Nintendo emulator focused on cycle-level precision, with true Super Game Boy support, HD Mode 7 graphics, and low-level coprocessor emulation for all SNES chips.
score_rationale: The gold standard for SNES accuracy with 1.9k stars; invaluable for preservation and reference even though development paused in 2020.
summary: Gold standard cycle-accurate SNES emulator for preservation
